plugins.name: superpowers-lite
plugins.description: Lighter fork of obra/superpowers — adds a developer-picked fast/middle/full lane so each task gets right-sized planning ceremony, from inline TodoWrite to full design-doc + plan-doc + multi-subagent review

plugins.name: superpowers-lite-teams
plugins.description: superpowers-lite with Agent Teams enabled by default — full lane routes through a team fitness check and runs parallel specialist execution when the plan benefits from it, falling back to subagent-driven serial execution otherwise. Requires Claude Code ≥ 2.1.32 with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1.
